secret.title: Copy it now
secret.description: This is the only time it is shown. We store only a fingerprint of it.

apiKeys.createDescription: API keys call your pools (and pools shared with you). They never manage anything.
apiKeys.scopeAllHint: Every pool you own or may use, including ones added later.
apiKeys.poolsUnavailable: Your pools could not be loaded. Choose all pools for now.
apiKeys.loadFailed: Could not load your API keys.
apiKeys.revokeDescription: Programs using this key stop working at once. This cannot be undone.

agents.mcpHint: Agents that support OAuth connect with this URL alone; others use a token below.
agents.tokensDescription: Tokens you give an agent. Only you can create or revoke them; agents can never create tokens or share anything.
agents.levelReadHint: Reads pools, runtimes, nodes, metrics and the request log. Changes nothing.
agents.levelFullHint: Everything an agent may do: configure, start and stop runtimes, and run commands and edit files on Full-control nodes. It can never grant access.
agents.loadFailed: Could not load your agent tokens.
agents.revokeDescription: The agent loses access at once. This cannot be undone.
agents.oauthDescription: Agents you approved in the browser.
agents.disconnectDescription: The agent must ask for your approval again to reconnect.
agents.mcpOff: MCP is turned off on this server, so agent tokens cannot be created.

shares.createDescription: Share with anyone by e-mail. Someone without an account gets an invite.
shares.noOwnPools: Create a pool before sharing one.
shares.poolsLoadFailed: Your pools could not be loaded.
shares.canUseHint: Call the pool with their own API keys.
shares.canContributeHint: Add their own served models to the pool.
shares.needOne: Choose can use, can contribute, or both.
shares.inviteLinkDescription: No e-mail could be sent. Give this link to {{email}}; it is shown only once and works until {{date}}.
shares.byMeEmpty: You have not shared a pool yet.
shares.withMeEmpty: Nothing is shared with you yet.
shares.removeDescription: They lose access at once. Models they contributed are removed from the pool.
shares.leaveDescription: You lose access at once, and models you contributed are removed from the pool.
shares.contributeOffDescription: Their {{count}} contributed models are removed from the pool.

contributions.empty: No pool lets you contribute yet. A pool's owner can share it with you with can contribute.
contributions.loadFailed: Could not load the pools you may contribute to.
contributions.noModels: You contribute nothing to this pool yet.
contributions.ownHardwareOnly: The owner routes to their own hardware only for now: your models stay listed but get no traffic.
contributions.addHint: Add one of your served models from the pool's page.
